svg.title: Heavenly Sonata — Music of the Spheres. Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Yin-Yang classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Opening Measure forks into Rising Crescendo then Fortissimo Finale, or Dissonant Chord then Prelude to Ruin. Harmonic Balance forks into Wall of Sound then Celestial Sanctum, or Muted Strings then Final Rest. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Yin-Yang jutsu.

Harmonic Balance answers \"How do I win defensively: shelter myself or silence them?\": Celestial Sanctum takes the Shield's self reduction 35 \u2192 45%, Final Rest takes Harmonic Chamber's suppression 35 \u2192 45%. Opening Measure answers \"How do I win offensively: amplify my own song or expose the target?\": Rising Crescendo lifts Lullaby's self buff and Fortissimo Finale pays off with +2 Damage (40 \u2192 42, 45 \u2192 47, no tier crossing), while Prelude to Ruin takes Interlude's exposure 35 \u2192 45% for every attacker. The earlier +5 Damage route (40 \u2192 45 twice, Frozen Melody 45 \u2192 50) is retired. No Afterburn, Lifesteal, Reflect or Heal row exists, so none is invented. Potency reaches matching supported tags on all Yin-Yang jutsu (RUL-2026-10-03-005)."},"nodes":[{"id":"01","name":"Opening Measure","category":"Foundation","cost":1,"parents":[],"modifiers":[{"tag":"increasedamagegiven","flat":2,"display_role":"SELF BUFF"},{"tag":"increasedamagetaken","flat":2,"display_role":"ENEMY DEBUFF"}],"flavor":"Every sonata begins with a single measure that decides how the rest will fall.","coverage_note":"Lullaby self buff 35 \u2192 37% (every non-pierce hit you land) and Foreboding Interlude exposure 35 \u2192 37% (Genjutsu or element-less hits on the target); 2 rounds after each cast.","parent_rule":"ALL","potency_classification":"Yin-Yang","scope":"all Yin-Yang jutsu","minimum_path_bp":1,"coverage":{"jutsu":["Foreboding Interlude","Lullaby"],"effect_rows":2}},{"id":"02","name":"Rising Crescendo","category":"Hidden Art","cost":1,"parents":["01"],"modifiers":[{"tag":"increasedamagegiven","flat":3,"display_role":"SELF BUFF"}],"flavor":"The melody swells, and every note that follows lands heavier.","coverage_note":"Lullaby self buff 37 \u2192 40% with Opening Measure: every non-pierce hit you land in the 2 rounds after the 60 AP cast, never Lullaby's own hit.","parent_rule":"ALL","potency_classification":"Yin-Yang","scope":"all Yin-Yang jutsu","minimum_path_bp":2,"coverage":{"jutsu":["Lullaby"],"effect_rows":1}},{"id":"03","name":"Fortissimo Finale","category":"Advanced Art","cost":1,"parents":["02"],"modifiers":[{"tag":"damage","flat":2,"display_role":"DAMAGE"}],"flavor":"The last movement, played at full voice, brings the heavens down.","coverage_note":"Burst: Foreboding Interlude and Lullaby 40 \u2192 42, Frozen Melody 45 \u2192 47 EP; every row stays in its tier. Harmonic Balance: \"How do I win defensively: shelter myself or silence them?\" (Fortress on the Shield, Suppression on the Chamber).","2026-10-04 rebalance: the +5 Damage route (Rising Crescendo +2, Fortissimo Finale +3) lifted Foreboding Interlude and Lullaby 40 \u2192 45 (Normal \u2192 High) and Frozen Melody 45 \u2192 50 (High \u2192 Nuke). Rising Crescendo is now +3% Increase Damage Given (setup on Lullaby's self buff) and Fortissimo Finale +2 Damage (payoff: 40 \u2192 42, 45 \u2192 47, no tier crossing). Prelude to Ruin drops its +3% Increase Damage Given rider: with Rising Crescendo on that tag, Prelude plus Rising Crescendo would stack +8% Increase Damage Given on top of +10% exposure. The defensive half is unchanged. Maxima over every legal allocation: Damage +2, Increase Damage Given +5%, Increase Damage Taken +10%, Decrease Damage Taken +10%, Decrease Damage Given +10%.","Magnitudes follow multipliers, not bands. At 3 BP, Frozen Melody inside both offensive windows takes \u00d71.40 \u00d7 1.37 on 47 EP on the Burst route and \u00d71.37 \u00d7 1.45 on 45 EP on the Exposure route, close enough that the choice is solo strike versus team mark; exposure's extra reach (allies' hits) is offset by its Genjutsu-only filter and single target, so it keeps +10% on its one row. Fortress and Suppression each take +10% on one row with a +2% rider of the other tank tag, as in the director-approved Arashima and Blood-Enchanted Eyes defensive halves; a reduction row moves \u00d70.65 \u2192 \u00d70.55.","Fourth purchases: Burst adds Dissonant Chord (exposure 40%) or Harmonic Balance; Exposure adds Rising Crescendo (Lullaby 40%) or Harmonic Balance; Fortress adds Muted Strings (suppression 42%) or Opening Measure; Suppression adds Wall of Sound (reduction 42%) or Opening Measure. No fourth adds to its own capstone's primary tag. All 14 full-budget allocations are numerically non-dominated.","Downstream reach: the bloodline passive (Increase Damage Given 25% + 0.15/level on Fire, Lightning, Yin-Yang, None) is not a potency target and applies last, after the kit rows multiply the hit in turn (computeDamagePacket, \u00a73b), so the +2 Damage is multiplied by every window and the passive. Lullaby's buff, the Shield's reduction and Harmonic Chamber's suppression list all four stat types and no element: every non-pierce hit. Interlude's exposure lists only Genjutsu: Genjutsu hits of any element and element-less hits, not elemental Nin/Tai/Buki.","Delivery and timing: all five jutsu are cooldown 7; Interlude, Melody and Lullaby cost 60 AP, Shield and Chamber 40 AP. Every buff/debuff row is live the two rounds after its cast round, never in it (\u00a73b), so Interlude's exposure never raises its own hit nor Lullaby's buff its own; Interlude, then Lullaby, then Frozen Melody puts the exposure on both later hits and the buff on Melody. The Shield's SELF row is realized on the caster at cast (\u00a74b), not via the circle tiles."],"risks":["Classification: element-wide Yin-Yang scope (RUL-2026-10-03-005): matching supported tags on all Yin-Yang jutsu, whatever their source; sharing Yin-Yang with other bloodlines is expected. 3 of the 7 supported rows carry Yin-Yang; Celestial Harmony Shield and Harmonic Chamber (no Yin-Yang row) qualify in-kit only through an authored jutsu classification (ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G1), so both tank routes depend on the proposed resolver. Off-kit Yin-Yang coverage is unverified.","Shield timing: the Decrease Damage Taken row has target SELF, so it is realized on the caster at cast, not via the circle tiles (actions.ts 980-1004; SOURCE_MECHANICS 4b): no standing-still cost, no enemy hazard. Like every modifier it skips its cast round and covers the two rounds after, so it must be cast a round ahead of the hits it should absorb.","Tank-row breadth: 45% suppression (40 AP) lowers the target's damage against allies too for the two rounds after the cast, beside drain 210 and cleanseprevent. Same-tag effects all apply and compound (process.ts 1109-1117): two casters' Chambers on one target give \u00d70.55 \u00d7 0.55 \u2248 \u00d70.30. Not simulated.","Offense stacking: the all-offense builds put Lullaby's 40% self buff and Interlude's 40-45% exposure on the same hit (\u00d71.96 to \u00d72.03), on top of other jutsu, main-tree or gear percentages; the bloodline passive applies last. Interlude's exposure also multiplies allies' Genjutsu and element-less hits on the target.","Realized value: three 60 AP attacks on cooldown 7 mean each 2-round window reaches at most the other two attacks per rotation, never its own jutsu's hit, so per-row numbers overstate per-round value. Lullaby's self buff needs another living user in range 4; aimed at an ally, its damage (friendly fire ALL) and buffprevent land on that ally (\u00a73b).","Frozen Melody is an AOE_CIRCLE_SPAWN with friendly fire ENEMIES (no ally hazard) and the kit's only multi-target reach; Fortissimo Finale lifts it 45 \u2192 47, below the 50 Nuke tier. Skill-tree effects are skipped in RANKED_PVP and RANKED_SPARRING at the pin. g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Yin-Yang jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Prelude to Ruin path + Harmonic Balance
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDG: Decrease Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE HEAVENLY SONATA KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Yin-Yang classification / forked tree
